import json
from pathlib import Path

import griffe

# `mod` is an already-loaded griffe.Module, e.g.:
# mod = griffe.load("some_package")

json_text = mod.as_json(indent=2, full=True)
Path("api.json").write_text(json_text, encoding="utf-8")

file_text = Path("api.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
reconstructed = json.loads(file_text, object_hook=griffe.json_decoder)

assert isinstance(reconstructed, griffe.Module)
assert reconstructed.name == mod.name
